newsitem.title: USA: Motorola's chairman salary at $1.08 mln.
newsitem.headline: Motorola's chairman salary at $1.08 mln.

text.p: Motorola Inc Chairman of the Board Gary Tooker will be paid a base salary of $1.08 million as of January 1, 1997, according to a proxy filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Tooker, as vice-chairman and chief executive officer of Motorola Inc, was given a raise in salary to $1.08 million for 1996 and received $760,000 in bonuses, the filing showed.
Motorola said for 1995 it paid Tooker a salary of $990,000 but gave him a larger bonus of $1.03 million.

Tooker, 57, became chairman of the board on January 1, 1997 and continues to be an officer and full-time employee of the company, although not a member of the chief executive office, Motorola said in the filing.
The Schaumburg, Illinois-based technology giant granted Tooker share options covering 80,000 shares in December 1996 as part of the company's annual option program.
The exercise price is $53.81 per share for all options that expire December 17, 2006, the filing said.
